title: The Guestbook
intro: Before you leave, sign the guestbook. In Vim you cannot just type: you have to ask for permission first.
startLines: GUESTBOOK - sign on the empty line, then save and quit.

targetLines: GUESTBOOK - sign on the empty line, then save and quit.

hints: Vim starts in Normal mode, where letters are commands. You need Insert mode.
Press i to start typing, and Esc when you are done.
Type: i, then I was here, then Esc, then :wq and Enter.
